title: internal-z2-gauge
description: The Z/2 group action on FOUR generated above the four-bilattice: the non-trivial element acts as negation ~ and the identity element acts as the identity map. It is the symmetry that makes FOUR's two orders a bilattice, fixing the knowledge-symmetric values and swapping true and false.

acts-on.description: FOUR, the four-element bilattice on which the gauge acts

group.description: the order-two cyclic group whose action constitutes the gauge

non-trivial-element.description: the non-identity element of Z/2 acts as negation ~

identity-element.description: the identity element of Z/2 acts as the identity map id

preserves-knowledge-order.description: the action is monotone for the knowledge order: x <=_k y implies ~x <=_k ~y

reverses-truth-order.description: the action is antitone for the truth order: x <=_t y implies ~y <=_t ~x

fixes-symmetric-values.description: fixes the knowledge-extreme values bottom and top while swapping t and f
